title: IME composition
scenario: A TextField and a RichTextEditor holding the W8.5 document of 65,472 UTF-16 units (seven-letter words), caret mid-document, 640x480 offscreen EmbeddedHost, reduced motion. Ten Hangul syllables are composed and committed through the production TSF text store with in-process doubles (the W8.5 scenario), no focus and no text service: one TSF lock per step, each followed by one frame. cppLargeAllocations counts allocations of at least one document's bytes (130,944 B). Proves the W8 gates. The history variant then makes 128 edits in the TextField, each its own undo step: proves W9.3's text-history gate (G13).
drawCalls: not counted: frame.drawCalls is 0 without the counting wrappers

phases.name: warm
phases.description: the first frame lays out both controls; then the TextField takes logical focus with its caret mid-document and its store answers the extent query a text service makes when a composition starts

phases.name: textfield
phases.description: TextField: step 2k is syllable k+1's read-write lock (selection, end, insert or rewrite of the composition, composition owner callback, caret, text read back), step 2k+1 its read lock (selection, end, extent, text); step 20 the commit lock

phases.name: switch
phases.description: the TextField's store is released; the RichTextEditor takes logical focus and its store answers the extent query

phases.name: richtext
phases.description: RichTextEditor: the same 21 locks as the TextField phase

phases.name: history
phases.description: history variant: the TextField takes logical focus again and step k makes edit k of 128 at its own place (W9.3); other variants: nothing
